11. Use the obtained red dyes and collected white wool to craft the required 2 orange wools.
12. With the orange wools and orange dyes, we can now craft the orange carpet pieces needed. Use 2 orange wools and 1 orange wool to craft 2 orange carpets.
13. With the gathered 2 orange carpets and previously crafted orange carpet (if needed), we use 8 white carpets and 2 orange carpets to craft 8 orange carpets.

6. Gather 2 white wool pieces and 2 red dyes to make 2 orange woollen pieces.
7. Use 2 orange wool pieces and 1 orange cloth to craft 2 orange carpets.
